text: Canada is losing more air traffic controllers to retirement than it is hiring, an aviation expert warns, raising serious concerns about preserving the reliable aviation system and high service standards Canadians rightly expect. Despite efforts to strengthen recruitment, maintaining this essential national infrastructure will require a firm focus on responsibility, competence, and continuity.
